source.snippet: Its now clear that we need to preserve tech press for non AI related things. Techmeme for example is now completely overrun with AI stories. HN is getting closer to that every day. If AI kickback deals, phony new model ratings, high RAM prices and your surprise at how you think you coded something with AI and it was AMAZING! even though it doesnt work is all there is count me out. We need a filter on existing tech news sites or an alternative press. [115 points, 63 comments, 2026-06-28]

problem_statement: Tech professionals who rely on industry news for work can no longer efficiently find non-AI tech stories because major outlets like Techmeme and HN are saturated with AI content, making it costly in time to stay informed on topics relevant to their actual work.
target_segment: Software engineers, indie developers, and tech-focused knowledge workers who follow industry news as part of their professional practice
notes: 115 upvotes and 63 comments on HN indicates broad resonance among a professional audience that pays for productivity tools. The request is for a filter or alternative press — both are monetizable (subscription newsletter, browser extension, filtered feed SaaS). Buyer signal is moderate: these are paying professionals but 'should be free' sentiment may also be present. Adjacent to existing paid products like TLDR, The Pragmatic Engineer, etc., suggesting willingness to pay exists in the segment.
